description: ZOU-420 recall-comparison fixture set — 12 queries x ~40 corpus docs (themed on the Zo/Zouroboros ecosystem). relevantDocIds is the ground-truth used to score recall@k. Override the fixture set with --fixtures <path>; the real recall delta is measured on the live annex (--live), not in this mechanical dry-run set.

corpus.text: The Zouroboros memory system uses a hybrid SQLite + vector store for persona continuity across conversations.
Qdrant is the vector database backing semantic retrieval for the qdrant-rag MCP server and the deep-research skill.
BGE-M3 is a multilingual embedding model producing 1024-dimensional vectors with strong MTEB retrieval scores, outperforming text-embedding-3-small on most benchmarks.
text-embedding-3-small is OpenAI's 1536-dimensional embedding model used as the current Qdrant baseline.
bge-reranker-v2 is a cross-encoder reranker that scores query-passage pairs directly, giving faster and more accurate reranking than listwise LLM rerankers.
RankGPT is a listwise reranking method that uses an LLM such as gpt-4o-mini to reorder candidate passages by relevance.
The consensus gate applies a BGP-style 3f+1 quorum across multiple models before promoting a memory fact or closing a swarm task.
HyDE generates a hypothetical answer to the query and embeds it alongside the original query to improve retrieval recall.
Corrective RAG (CRAG) scores the top retrieval result and falls back to query rewriting or web search when confidence is low.
FlashRank is a lightweight ONNX cross-encoder used by rerankFast for zero-API-cost local reranking on CPU.
Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) merges multiple ranked lists by summing 1/(k+rank) contributions, k=60 by default.
The Hetzner GPU annex (ZOU-414) hosts self-hosted inference for embeddings, rerankers, and vLLM proposer models reached over HTTP.
HuggingFace text-embeddings-inference (TEI) and Infinity expose OpenAI-compatible /v1/embeddings and a /rerank endpoint for self-hosted models.
FlashRank is a lightweight ONNX cross-encoder used by rerankFast for zero-API-cost local reranking on CPU.
Dormant-until-armed is the contract for opt-in tiers: a feature is byte-identical to the default until an environment variable explicitly arms it.
The moa provider mixes three vendor proposers (GLM-5.2, Kimi-K2.6, DeepSeek-V4) via OpenRouter and synthesizes with an aggregator.
NV-Embed-v2 is a decoder-only embedding model from NVIDIA that achieves state-of-the-art MTEB scores and produces 4096-dimensional vectors.
Cosine similarity is the default vector distance metric for ranking Qdrant search results by semantic relevance to a query.
The Zouroboros Software Factory intake pipeline runs spec-first interviews, seed YAML generation, and three-stage evaluation before merging.
Gap audits check reachability, data prerequisites, cross-boundary state, and eval-production parity before closing a swarm task.
The fastrrst reranker path is one-shot Python subprocess spawning the rerank-fast.py ONNX model to avoid worker deadlocks.
Embedding dimensionality must match between the index collection and the query vector or Qdrant returns a dimension mismatch error.
Token-cost accounting separates vendor token spend from amortized self-host cost to avoid silently double-counting local tokens at the vendor rate.
The deep-research skill chains peer-reviewed literature, open web, and the internal Qdrant corpus into a provenance-tracked synthesis report.
A retrievable knowledge graph (codebase-memory) returns ranked function signatures and caller edges at a fraction of the tokens of whole-file reads.
Reindexing a Qdrant collection requires recreating it at the new model's vector dimension and re-ingesting every document with the new embeddings.
The zo-memory-system Skill is the live runtime home for the model-client, qdrant-rag MCP, and the memory gate hook.
A cross-encoder reranker scores each candidate independently against the query, then sorts by score, unlike a listwise ranker that sees all candidates at once.
BM25 sparse retrieval and dense vector retrieval are fused via RRF to combine lexical precision with semantic recall in hybrid search.
MTEB (Massive Text Embedding Benchmark) is the standard evaluation suite for comparing embedding models across retrieval, classification, and clustering tasks.
The hermes-docs collection in Qdrant stores chunked Hermes Agent documentation ingested by the ingest-hermes-docs script.
A self-hosted embedding service eliminates recurring per-token API costs at the expense of GPU hardware and operational overhead.
The MemoryConfig embeddingModel field selects the embedding model id and embeddingDimension controls the Qdrant vector size.
Graceful degradation means a single tier's failure never breaks the pipeline; it falls back to the next available path.
RankGPT listwise reranking latency grows with the number of candidate passages and the LLM's generation time, making local cross-encoders faster at scale.
Dedup and rate-limit throttling in the embeddings module cap embedding calls per conversation to avoid memory explosion under high recall loads.
The Fauna and Flora Botanicals site uses a weekly design-md drift guard that lints DESIGN.md against the Google Labs spec.
Aventurine Capital's institutional trading platform wires a pretrade gate that consults the consensus quorum before executing an order.
Recall@k measures the fraction of ground-truth relevant documents that appear in the top-k retrieved results for a query.
A recall comparison harness must embed the corpus and queries with each model under test separately to avoid cross-model dimension or scale mismatch.
